steps.title: Define Project Metadata
steps.description: Assert and configure application metadata for Retro Brick Breaker including app name and package namespace.

steps.title: Redesign UI Overlay Layout Architecture
steps.description: Rebuild activity_main.xml to replace full-screen blockers with floating retro glassmorphic cards and polished monospace guides over the active background view.

steps.title: Implement Drifting Space Starfield background
steps.description: Program a high-performance custom particle array representing a drifting, twinkling synthwave star system drifting over the background canvas.

steps.title: Create Scrolling Matrix Grid Decoration
steps.description: Code moving horizontal background line trackers inside GameView rendering cycles to build an active vector horizon parallax effect.

steps.title: Build Multi-ball Neon Trails
steps.description: Implement history arrays on Ball trackers to calculate and draw fading motion trailing segments on high-speed canvas movements.

steps.title: Program Dynamic Emitter Particles
steps.description: Architect a dedicated physical particle emitter triggered on brick hit or breakage to spray vibrant, fading neon colors matching the struck brick's style.

steps.title: Implement Impact Screen Shake Engine
steps.description: Incorporate translation shake matrices on the canvas drawing routines triggered by life-loss, brick breaks, and critical state occurrences.

steps.title: Stylize Specular Bricks & Tube-Neon Paddle
steps.description: Enhance canvas draw rules with gloss top reflections, multi-hit strength labels, and multi-layered glow borders on the retro paddle controller.

steps.title: Connect Interactive Power-Up Identifiers
steps.description: Update power-up renderings with dynamic custom symbols corresponding to wide paddle, extra health, slow-motion, and splits.

steps.title: Create State-List Programmatic Selectors
steps.description: Configure state list drawables in MainActivity.java to bind rounded, glowing custom retro gradients with responsive pressed states for all buttons.

steps.title: Building Retro Brick Breaker
steps.description: Compile final debug executable build checking complete backward Java 8 compatibility and standard AGP rules.
